newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse creeps up in mixed trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse creeps up in mixed trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index continued upward but at a slower pace in a mixed trading session, bourse officials said on Thursday.
The index gained 0.06 points to close at 3515.25.
Turnover was posted at 26.9 million shillings traded on 580,352 shares compared to 26.7 million shillings on 1,561,868 shares.
Brokers said they were positive about the market and said the overriding market sentiment was bullish.
Barclays Bank traded at 115 from 111 while Kenya Commercial Bank was unchanged at 108. Standard Chartered Bank eased to 46.75 frp, 47.25.
Uchumi Supermarket eased a shilling to close at 38 while Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.20.
Rea Vipingo Plantations closed at 9.25 from 9.10 while Brooke Bond gained a shilling to close at 124.
Kenya Power & Lighting eased to 170 from 175 while Kenya Breweries shed 50 cents to close at 57.
Foreign investors traded East African Portland Cement at between 40.75 and 41.25 from 40.25 and Sasini Tea & Coffee at 81.50 from 80.
